'''Kin Laron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Laron flew the ship ''[[Hell's Axe]]'' and made herself a career as an assassin. By assuming the identity of "Shiaer Hifron," a trader who was also secretly her informant, Laron was able to keep her species and sex a secret, by meeting with clients posing as Hifron, who she pretended arranged deals for her.<ref name="WBC" />

Laron used seduction and deceit to get close to her targets, so only took contracts to assassinate men. She would then kill her targets aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] while they slept, using capsules of [[RX-8]], a poisonous gas.<ref name="WBC" />

During the time of the New Republic, Laron took four [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] from the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Gornt Seron]] to kill some men, including one called [[Den Hardon]]. By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the New Republic had posted a bounty of 25,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Laron, although they had no idea as to her physical appearance and true identity.<ref name="WBC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laron was first mentioned in the sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]. She was later referenced in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', in the entries of Shiaer Hifron and ''Hell's Axe'', where her name was misspelled as Kyr Laron.
